svg.aria-label: One carrier period with the reference held at level r: the crossing times are linear in r, giving duty cycle one plus r over two and an average of r times V_dc
svg.text: Inside one carrier period the triangle is a ruler: crossing time is linear in the reference

text.tspan: v vs. t over one carrier period — duty D = (1 + r)/2, so the average is r·V_dc
